modelDescription: Built from the most advanced materials, the Summit Ti is the ultimate refinement of our passion for carbon fiber. The titanium action is machined with a 0 MOA picatinny split rail, matched with a light target contour Christensen Arms carbon fiber wrapped barrel, and finished with a titanium radial muzzle brake. Gunstock options include our legendary aerograde carbon fiber stocks in both sporter and thumbhole options. The Summit Ti weighs in starting at 5.5 pounds and features a Christensen Arms Half-MOA Guarantee.
